sections.name: InternshipModal (part 1)
sections.title: Form state and AI fill
sections.what: Sets up the form fields, filling them from the application being edited or leaving them blank for a new one. Defines the AI fill action, which copies the AI result into the fields. Starts the save action.
sections.why: Likely reason: one form serves both adding and editing, so it starts from the existing values when editing.
sections.watch_out: The AI fill overwrites fields such as role, location, and notes even when the AI returns blanks, which can erase what the user typed.

sections.name: InternshipModal: if
sections.title: Save as update or new entry
sections.what: On save, trims the text fields. If the form was opened for an existing application, updates it; otherwise adds a new one. Then closes the form.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps add and edit in a single save action.
sections.watch_out: The save ignores an empty company silently, with no message to the user.

sections.name: InternshipModal (part 3)
sections.title: Pop-up frame and AI quick-fill
sections.what: Draws the pop-up frame and the plain-language box with a text field, a voice button, and an Auto-Fill button, plus a success line after filling. Company name field is at the start of the form.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the user describe an application in plain words instead of typing each field.
sections.watch_out: The Auto-Fill button is disabled while the AI is busy or the box is empty.

sections.name: InternshipModal (part 4)
sections.title: Role, stage, location, and dates
sections.what: Form fields for role title, pipeline stage (a select list of six stages), location, compensation, applied date, and application deadline.
sections.why: Likely reason: the core details of an application, with the stage choice shown next to the role.
sections.watch_out: The stage list is typed in by hand and must match the stage names used on the board, or entries will not appear in a column.

sections.name: InternshipModal (part 5)
sections.title: Resume, portfolio, notes, and buttons
sections.what: Fields for the resume file name used, a portfolio link, and free notes, followed by Cancel and Save buttons. The save label changes when editing.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the record of what was sent and what to remember.
sections.watch_out: The resume field is free text, so it stores a name only and does not check that the file exists.
